documentation: Tuning constants and sources. Seasons, teams, fixtures, scores and home advantage are read from the data on every run. Settings were chosen on the previous season, each day or week predicted only from earlier games. Bookmaker moneylines: NFL from nflverse; NBA and NHL from ESPN's scoreboard (DraftKings), saved before each game starts in data/market.json.

rules.name: A
rules.text: Bet our favourite when it is the away team and the bookmaker's chance for it (margin taken out) is at least 1 point higher than ours.
rules.found: Checked on closing moneylines with the EPA model, each week predicted only from earlier weeks: this season to week 11, 27 bets, 24 won, +24%; last season 43 bets, +9.8%. Low prices (about 1.40), so one loss costs a lot. On the page for testing only.

rules.name: H
rules.text: Bet the home team on the moneyline when our win chance for it is above 50% and the gap (ours minus the bookmaker's, margin taken out) is -12 points or lower, as the table shows them.
rules.found: Checked on closing moneylines with the EPA model, each week predicted only from earlier weeks: this season to week 11, 17 bets, 15 won, +2.5 units (+14.5%); last season 22 bets, 17 won, -1.0 unit (-4.4%). Very low prices (about 1.25-1.30), so one loss wipes out three or four wins. On the page for testing only.

rule.name: F
rule.text: Bet our favourite when the bookmaker's chance for it (margin taken out) is 5 to 10 points higher than ours. When the market rates our favourite even higher than we do, it usually wins more often than either of us says; much further apart, something like a missing star is usually behind it.
rule.found: Found on closing DraftKings prices: last season 246 bets, +7.0%; this season to 16 November 40 bets, +5.1% (286 bets, 81% won, average odds 1.33, +19.2 units). Many rules were tried to find it, so treat it as a test.

rules.name: R1
rules.text: Bet the home team to win in regulation (60 minutes) when our chance for it, overtime included, is above 50% and the gap (ours minus the bookmaker's, margin taken out) is below -6 points, as the table shows them.
rules.found: Picked from this season's games: to 23 November 30 bets, 23 won in regulation. Settled at our own 60-minute odds, as there are no bookmaker three-way prices here; a bookmaker usually pays a few percent less. The same games on the moneyline lost last season (about -14%). On the page for testing only.

rules.name: R2
rules.text: Bet the away team to win in regulation (60 minutes) when our chance for it, overtime included, is above 50% and the gap (ours minus the bookmaker's, margin taken out) is below +2 points, as the table shows them.
rules.found: Picked from this season's games: to 23 November 89 bets, 53 won in regulation. Settled at our own 60-minute odds, as there are no bookmaker three-way prices here; a bookmaker usually pays a few percent less. The same games on the moneyline won this season (about +7%) and lost last season (about -6%). On the page for testing only.
